_purpose: Third-party hiring channel for Kelvi's DevOps/SRE/Platform/Cloud job hunt: staffing, IT-recruitment, RPO, executive-search and interview-as-a-service firms that recruit for OTHER companies. This is a manual-outreach + profile-registration registry — NOT employers to scan for postings (see companies.json) and NOT job boards to search (see platforms.json). Most of these firms only get paid when a candidate they represent is hired, so registering a profile / sending a targeted resume is low-risk and worth doing in bulk.
_priority: As of 2026-09-03, on Kelvi's instruction, third-party IT staffing / talent-acquisition firms (priority 'P1' below) are the PRIORITY sourcing channel for this job hunt — work these first, in parallel with (not after) the direct-portal and job-board channels. Rationale: these firms have live vendor relationships with the exact BFSI GCCs / product companies / MNCs already in companies.json, often surface contract-to-hire and un-advertised reqs, and a single profile registration puts Kelvi in front of many clients at once. See the 'recruiter-outreach' skill for how to actually work this channel.

_priorityModel.P1: IT / tech-specialist staffing firm with real DevOps/SRE/Cloud/Platform contract or perm placement flow into India GCCs, product companies, or MNCs. Register a candidate profile + send a targeted resume. Work these first.
_priorityModel.P2: Generalist staffing / permanent-placement / RPO firm that also does tech but is not tech-first, or a tech firm whose India footprint / model needs verifying. Register where a candidate portal exists; otherwise a short intro email.
_priorityModel.P3: Executive search (skews senior/leadership — Kelvi is mid-IC), interview-as-a-service / assessment vendors (encountered inside other companies' loops, limited direct 'apply'), background-verification/RPO, or a niche/unverified firm. Lower yield for this profile — light touch, revisit if a specific role appears.

_typeLegend.staff-aug-c2h: Staff augmentation / contract / contract-to-hire — you may be on the staffing firm's payroll, deployed at a client. Common route into GCCs.
_typeLegend.perm-placement: Permanent / full-time placement, contingency (paid on hire). Standard 'recruiter representing you to a client'.
_typeLegend.rpo: Recruitment Process Outsourcing — the firm runs a client's whole hiring funnel; a good profile with them = being in that client's pipeline directly.
_typeLegend.exec-search: Retained / executive search — board & senior-leadership mandates. Mostly above Kelvi's band; keep for future.
_typeLegend.iaas: Interview-as-a-service / technical assessment vendor. Their clients outsource interview rounds to them; as a candidate you meet them inside another company's loop, not via a direct application.
_typeLegend.bgv-rpo: Background verification + RPO / onboarding services. Not a sourcing channel; listed so a firm that contacts Kelvi is recognizable.

_statusLegend.Verified: Public contact email found on the firm's own website at compile time — safe to email directly (re-verify, addresses change).
_statusLegend.Portal: Firm runs a public candidate job-search / profile-registration portal — register there rather than emailing.
_statusLegend.Form: No public email and no real candidate portal — reach via a website enquiry/contact form.
_statusLegend.LinkedIn: Best reached by following the firm and connecting with its India tech recruiters on LinkedIn; little/no candidate-facing web path.

_howThisFeedsTheMechanism.channels: companies.json = direct career portals (channel owned by the 'company-portals' skill). platforms.json = LinkedIn + job boards ('job-platforms' skill). recruiters.json = this file, third-party firms ('recruiter-outreach' skill).
_howThisFeedsTheMechanism.automationStatus: No script reads this file, and the scheduled cloud routine does not yet act on it. Making the recruiter channel a live part of the 3x/day routine requires a prompt change via /schedule — see ROUTINE.md 'Recruiter / third-party staffing channel'. Until then, 'recruiter-outreach' is a manual/assisted workflow Kelvi (or Claude, on request) runs.
_howThisFeedsTheMechanism.keepInSync: profile.json is the source of truth for target roles / locations / salary. APPLY-REFERENCE.md is the source of truth for identity/contact answers on registration forms. Do not restate those here — link to them.
